sources.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: DDIM：確定性去噪更新
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付加噪分解、累積排程與訊噪比表。；.9與.5正確，訊號與噪音平方係數和1，seed可重現。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver noise decomposition, cumulative schedules and SNR tables.; Results match, squared signal/noise coefficients sum1 and seeds reproduce outputs.
related.difference: 畫目前xt、預測ε、推回xhat0及較早排程點；標明時間由噪到淨。；兩值吻合，α1端點正確，固定輸入重跑一致。
related.differenceEn: Draw current xt,predicted epsilon,reconstructed xhat0 and the earlier schedule point; label noisy-to-clean time direction.; Both values match, alpha1 endpoint is correct and fixed-input reruns agree.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: η=0示例更新x前=√α前 xhat0+√(1−α前)εhat；預測量固定以隔離排程影響。；教學xhat0=1,εhat=.5,α前=.81；改α前=.64。；x前=.9+.5√.19=1.117944947；改後.8+.5×.6=1.1。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: xt=√αbar x0+√(1−αbar)ε; cumulative αbar differs from per-step α.; Teaching x0=1.5,epsilon−.5,alpha-bar.64 then.36.; xt=.8×1.5+.6×(−.5)=.9; changed result=.5.

For eta0,x_prev=√alpha_prev xhat0+√(1−alpha_prev)epsilon_hat; freeze predictions to isolate the schedule.; Teaching xhat0=1,epsilon_hat.5,alpha_prev.81 then.64.; x_prev=.9+.5√.19=1.117944947; changed result1.1.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: mixup：輸入與軟標籤同步混合
related.titleEn: mixup: synchronized input and soft-label mixing
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付加噪分解、累積排程與訊噪比表。；.9與.5正確，訊號與噪音平方係數和1，seed可重現。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver noise decomposition, cumulative schedules and SNR tables.; Results match, squared signal/noise coefficients sum1 and seeds reproduce outputs.
related.difference: 列輸入、one-hot標籤、配對索引與λ四欄，產生軟標籤[.25,.75]。；8與4正確，交換不變性成立，target和1且無整數截斷。
related.differenceEn: List inputs,one-hot labels,pair indices and lambda to form soft label[.25,.75].; Results match,swap invariance holds and targets sum1 without truncation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: xmix=λxa+(1−λ)xb，標籤必用同一λ與同一配對。；教學標量xa2,xb10,λ.25；改λ.75。；xmix=.25×2+.75×10=8；改後4。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: xt=√αbar x0+√(1−αbar)ε; cumulative αbar differs from per-step α.; Teaching x0=1.5,epsilon−.5,alpha-bar.64 then.36.; xt=.8×1.5+.6×(−.5)=.9; changed result=.5.
xmix=lambda xa+(1−lambda)xb; labels must use the same lambda and pairing.; Teaching scalar inputs2 and10,lambda.25 then.75.; xmix=.25×2+.75×10=8; changed result4.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
